about: v04-cal-r1-2026-11: round 1 of the v0.4 task calibration on Opus 5.5 (OpenClaw and Hermes, gbrain told-live against none), its summaries as recorded and regraded, its round file, the decision that picked it, and the report's tables across all four rounds and the transfer check.

known.reason: The report pasted cal-report.ts's final states table under its own heading, "Final verdicts, recorded and regraded", instead of the printed one; the table rows are in the report unchanged.

The report rewrote cal-report.ts's printed transfer table by hand into a wider table (adding the round 1 dev rates and the verdicts); every count in this printed row appears there unchanged, and round/report-tables.json, which holds the same counts, rebuilds exactly.

not_rebuilt.reason: Rebuilt by hand with scripts/regrade.ts, they match line for line apart from two fields, but every line records the grader's commit id and the absolute folder the evidence was read from, and verify compares .jsonl files as plain text with no way to set those two fields aside; regrade.ts also exits 1 whenever a grade moved, which verify reads as a failed step. The regraded summary and round files below are rebuilt from the committed copy.

scripts/v04/clean-arm-audit.ts audit needs each trial's own harness trace under logs/turns/, and only logs/adapter.log of each trial's harness logs was committed, so a rebuild would report every scored trial as unaudited.

A shell check, not a script in the repository, that counted planned trials, trial records and trial folders per cell on the run machine before the results were committed; its header names that machine's working folder.

not_rebuilt.what: The native memory check after round 1
not_rebuilt.reason: It was counted from each none trial's harness workspace, state and per-turn harness logs, which were not committed (FULL-TREES.md says where the full trees are archived), and no script in the repository writes it.

rebuild_only.reason: summarize-run.ts gained the headroom section (how many tasks can tell the arms apart) in commit 5ddc1a40b2 (2026-11-09); the published file was written by an earlier version of the script.
